verdict.rationale: Jules is cloud-based (async agents run in VMs), notifies users when input is needed, requires plan/PR approvals, and community reports confirm reviewing/approving PRs from a phone-like workflow while agents work (jules-comm-12). However, there's no dedicated mobile app or explicit mobile-optimized approval UI documented, only a web app with notifications. missing for 10: dedicated mobile app or mobile-specific approval UI, evidence of push notifications to phone, hands-on confirmation of approving plans/PRs specifically via phone browser at scale.
